rule: Present one priority decision at a time. A building packet is READY only when the actual visible experience—not a functional skeleton—clears the non-compensable building-as-experience and LAiDIES brand-world floors, and the question, recommendation, options, trade-offs, visual evidence, approval boundary, consequence of waiting and exact response are complete.

delivery.sourceOfTruth: The Control Room Action Centre is the canonical Ali decision queue. The Review Inbox is used when the decision requires watching, listening to or inspecting an exact artifact.
delivery.interruptRule: Notify Ali in the active Codex task only when a packet reaches READY and the work cannot proceed safely without her choice. A blocked owner lane is not, by itself, an Ali decision.
notificationContents: the exact decision in plain language
the consequence of each option and of waiting
the exact bounded response Ali can send
delivery.resolutionPath: Ali chooses one option in the Action Centre, copies the generated exact response and sends it in the active Codex task. Control Room then records a durable receipt, wakes the named execution owner and reports the resulting evidence.
delivery.reminderRule: Every unresolved READY packet is rechecked during the daily Control Room review and remains in Your decision now until a durable receipt closes or supersedes it.
delivery.staleRule: A READY packet with missing evidence, a broken preview, an overdue review date or a superseding artifact is demoted to NOT READY and returned to its owner; it may not remain presented to Ali.

packets.title: Homepage Cycle 5 visual-language championship — rejected
packets.question: Closed: Ali rejected Cycle 5 and preserved the current Homepage incumbent.
packets.plainEnglish: Cycle 5 is rejected/stale/withdrawn evidence only. The comparison itself was invalid because Option A was a contaminated mutable working copy—not the approved incumbent—with stale Episode 04 status, three unapproved hero actions, first-visit/current modules, white readiness cards and internal platform language. Cycle 5 repeated the copy/vocabulary/white-box failures.

recommendation.summary: Keep the current Homepage incumbent and restart with conservative authoritative-asset and duplication/hierarchy improvements only.
why: The candidate rewrote approved public language with route, receiver, readiness, receipt and navigation-not-completion vocabulary.
It misclassified LAiDIES buildings and destinations as routes.
Its six-card white status grid repeats the boring boxed-page pattern Ali explicitly rejected.
Prior sealed-render, technical and Town Entry checks did not judge these locked product and Brand constraints.
The local index.html has been surgically restored to the clean visitor-facing incumbent; nothing was deployed.
Cycle 5 cannot be revised or propagated; it remains only as failure evidence.

options.label: Decision closed
options.meaning: Cycle 5 is rejected and no longer accepts approval or revision.
options.tradeoff: None. Technical evidence is retained without keeping the failed product direction alive.
options.receipt: REJECTED — Cycle 5 Homepage. Do not integrate, propagate or present as decision-ready.

options.label: Restart underway
options.meaning: Brand is building a new incumbent-based candidate limited to authoritative asset substitutions and duplication/hierarchy reductions.
options.tradeoff: Ali is not interrupted again until the replacement passes copy-preservation, vocabulary, no-white-box, Brand and Town Entry gates.
options.receipt: NO ACTION REQUIRED — wait for a materially better incumbent-based candidate.

whatThisDoesNotApprove: Any live Homepage, route or shared-style mutation
Automatic propagation to every building, Study Pack, card, postcard or Closet asset
Final placement of the motion ident or episode media
Any new spend, external service, account or private-data authority

evidence.summary: Cycle 5 passed sealed-render and bounded Town Entry checks, but Ali rejected the visible product because those gates failed to enforce locked copy, vocabulary and no-white-box requirements.
remainingRisks: A technically passing artifact may be falsely promoted again unless every Homepage gate checks exact public-copy preservation, building vocabulary and the no-white-box rule.
No replacement candidate is yet internally admitted.
